metadata.description: Portable, cross-platform Claude Code agent environment: Codex MCP, working modes, inherited claudex Fast delegation, and a model-aware statusline.

plugins.name: claude-hud
plugins.description: Real-time statusline HUD (context bar, tools, agents, todos, git). Bundled here so it auto-installs as this plugin's dependency.

plugins.name: caveman
plugins.description: Terse response style that keeps technical substance while dropping filler. Bundled so a new machine gets the same working style.

plugins.name: dmd
plugins.description: Cursor-style debug mode for Claude Code: NDJSON logs and the dmd CLI. Bundled so debugging works the same on every machine.

plugins.name: cc-portable-bootstrap
plugins.description: One-command setup of a portable Claude Code agent environment: stable Codex MCP, Sol/Luna/Terra modes, claudex launchers with inherited downstream Fast defaults, and a statusline showing real GPT context plus official quota.
